datasheet_identity.title: MM1W3V3 THRU MM1W330 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: The MM1W24 row specifies VZ minimum 22.8 V, nominal 24 V, and maximum 26.0 V at IZT = 11 mA, maximum ZZT = 25 ohm, maximum IR = 5 uA at VR = 18 V, and admissible IZM = 38 mA, all at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
The supplied PDF contains only power-derating and transient-thermal-impedance plots; it has no MM1W24-specific zener I-V curve or other usable electrical curve.
The capacitance and reverse-recovery fields are unavailable because the datasheet publishes neither a capacitance specification nor trr or switching-time data.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable MM1W24-specific electrical curve is present: the PDF publishes only generic power-derating and transient-thermal-impedance plots. The datasheet also publishes no capacitance or reverse-recovery specification.
